title: Zero retail markup

posts.caption:
Many big name shoes can start in local workshops. The markup comes later.

Retail adds its markup on the way to you. We visit Pakistani workshops, choose finished men's leather shoes and sneakers, check every pair by hand, then re-lace, tag, seal and box it. You pay for the shoe, with Cash on Delivery across Pakistan.

First photo: mood photography of leather craft (Pexels), not our workshop. Kit shown is a design render.

Send this to someone who just paid retail for leather shoes.
